title: A draft press is pinned to the container agent and the reconciler cannot run a single tick
body: A draft press runs ONE tick now; its run's epic is the tick id itself, which the reconciler's graph-driven wave planning cannot express, so drafts.ts passes submitRun an explicit driver: "agent" opt-out (tick nu9's one named exception). If the reconciler is to own every dispatch surface, it needs a single-tick path (a synthetic one-tick epic, or an explicit tick-scoped plan).
